evidenceClass: Controlled Pi bash tool execution against synthetic files in disposable Linux containers; no model or live account.
metric: Measured UTF-8 bytes and Unicode characters; estimated input tokens = ceil(characters / 4), not tokenizer counts.
caseGate: Every applicable required check passes in the same run. Availability and compact checks intentionally fail on the red baseline.

checks.C1-installed: RTK 0.51.0 executes successfully in the workspace; applies to every case.
checks.C2-exit: The Pi result reports the expected success or failure; applies to every case.
checks.C3-semantic: Every independent expected filename, changed value or commit subject occurs in the visible result; applies to compact cases and explicit failure and R7 merge history.
checks.C4-compact: In each repetition, the sum of visible characters across the nine equally used display commands is lower than the matching raw sum. Applies to the display cases as one shared aggregate gate; individual outputs may grow.
checks.C5-exact: Machine status is byte-identical to raw output, exported CSV bytes match the independent input, and patch bytes match raw Git output; applies to R1, R2 and R3 and R5 and R7 (complete merge history).
checks.C6-status-class: Staged addition, three unstaged modifications, unstaged deletion and untracked file retain their correct status classes; applies to B1.v2 and H2.v2.
checks.C7-patch-content: Saved patches contain the independent fixture expectations: the staged export file addition and all changed values and deleted content in the unstaged tracked files; applies to R3.v2 and R5.v2.
checks.C8-rtk-used: The execution trace records a real RTK command invocation beyond rewrite probing. A disposable PATH shim logs arguments then execs the installed binary without changing output; applies to the nine display cases.
